hotels.title: Elegant Fairmont Hanoi Luxury in the Heart of Vietnam’s Captivating Capital
hotels.description: Set in Hanoi’s diplomatic quarter beside tranquil Hoan Kiem Lake, this refined retreat places the Old Quarter’s French-colonial facades, Ngoc Son Temple and the Hanoi Opera House within easy reach. Interiors draw on the city’s storied heritage with polished marble, lacquered details and artful Vietnamese design. Days can begin with pastries and coffee in the elegant lobby lounge, followed by restorative treatments at the spa and laps in the indoor pool. Nearby, Trang Tien Plaza offers designer shopping, and the tree-lined boulevards of the French Quarter lead to atmospheric bistros and galleries
